author: John Hammond
description:
This payload uses a few simple Windows commands in a clever way to search through Firefox profile files and identify a specific file to execute.

It is a small part of a broader malware analysis that looks at how attackers can abuse built-in Windows functionality to carry out their payloads.

Watch the full video: https://youtu.be/oJHOlNTH7lY?si=8LruOkxZlfvFLII-
title: Firefox Profile Payload
